claims.claim: Big tire bicycle with complete accessories
claims.evidence: Report shows fat tires, fenders, rear cargo rack, and saddle, but does not show all accessories or confirm they are complete.
Report lists age and mileage as not shown; photos cannot reveal purchase date.
Report shows disc brakes but cannot confirm function or perfect condition from still photos.
Report does not mention rust or confirm its absence.
Report shows no readable brand or model and cannot verify originality of components.

risks.risk: Battery does not hold a charge
risks.proof: Video of the bike powering on, showing battery level, and running under load.
risks.if_unproven: as with a dead or non-functional battery

risks.risk: Motor and electronics do not function
risks.proof: Video of throttle or pedal assist engaging and the motor running.
Photo of the charger and keys together with the bicycle.

risks.risk: Hidden frame or component damage not visible in the photo
risks.proof: Detailed video or close-up photos of the frame, welds, battery casing, and motor housing.

risks.risk: Age or mileage is higher than claimed
risks.proof: Original purchase receipt or odometer reading.

risks.risk: Photo may be a stock or retailer image rather than the actual item for sale
risks.proof: Video of the bicycle with a handwritten note and today's date.

proof_requests: Video of the bicycle turning on, displaying battery charge, and the motor running.
Photo of the charger and keys with the bicycle.
Close-up video of the frame, battery casing, and motor housing to rule out hidden damage.
Original purchase receipt to verify age.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as an electric fat tire bicycle, so it can be priced at its worst case with a dead battery, non-functioning motor, missing accessories, and hidden damage; proof would raise the value.
